description: The API is not consistent about the casing of Trade.type. GET /trades/recent sends lowercase "buy"/"sell"; the trades embedded in GET /tokens/{network}/{tokenAddress} send uppercase "BUY"/"SELL". Both were observed against production on 2026-08-03.
contract: A caller must be able to tell a buy from a sell without knowing which endpoint the trade came from. TypeScript, Go and Python surface Trade.type exactly as the server sent it and offer a case-insensitive comparison (TradeType.Is in Go, .toLowerCase()/.lower() elsewhere); Rust folds the case during deserialisation because its TradeSide is already a normalising enum, and anything genuinely unrecognised still keeps its exact wire text in TradeSide::Other. What none of them do is quietly rewrite an unrecognised value.
